edits.before: Swain wins by landing Demonic Ascension, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Swain wins by landing Nevermove into Vision of Empire, then draining through fights your kit cannot shorten pre-6.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Trade when Nevermove (E, 12s) is down: E-tick him as he steps to the wave, Q-silence his answer, and back off before the root threat comes back online.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget spell shield (Iron Boundary) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Demonic Ascension: 120s — his drain mode, and your R suppresses him straight through it. - Nevermove (E): 12s at rank 1 — every kill combo starts there; it down means free farm. - Your Nether Grasp is 140/110/80 — budget Void Shift for the root, R for the drain.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP lets you crash, base, and return before the bounce. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.

edits.before: E a caster minion and let the visions farm for you — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from the first wave.
edits.after: His Vision of Empire poke and Nevermove root out-pressure your bare kit — take safe last-hits and concede a little ground.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: He still zones you off the wave with poke and 850-range Nevermove — save your Q silence for the root attempt.

edits.before: Nether Grasp online — with ANY jungle presence you now have a guaranteed kill button. The lane bends around your 6.
edits.after: Nether Grasp suppresses him straight through Demonic Ascension — his drain never starts, and jungle presence makes it a kill.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: visions melt waves AND health bars. Suppress-into-burn kills through most defensive answers.
